ideas.pitch: An AI-powered document translator and interactive form-filler that simplifies complex government welfare and scheme applications for rural and non-technical citizens.
ideas.problem_statement: Reimagine Government: Rethink how citizens interact with government websites and digital services.
ideas.title: GovSimplified
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the accessibility theme directly by removing bureaucratic and language hurdles, aligning with the hackathon's mission to make tech accessible to non-CS backgrounds like Arts and Humanities.

ideas.pitch: A geo-tagged municipal grievance routing platform that uses NLP to automatically categorize citizen complaints and route them to the correct local government department with real-time tracking.
ideas.problem_statement: Reimagine Government: Rethink how citizens interact with government websites and digital services.
ideas.title: CitizenPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on high-impact civic utility with a working live demo, showing clear measurable impact for local municipal governance.

ideas.pitch: A conversational AI assistant that helps students and parents discover, understand, and apply for government educational scholarships and subsidies through voice commands in regional languages.
ideas.problem_statement: Reimagine Government: Rethink how citizens interact with government websites and digital services.
ideas.title: ScholarScheme Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the school students and diverse academic backgrounds participating in Hackcache'26 by solving a real financial literacy and access problem.

ideas.pitch: A guided wizard interface that helps everyday citizens draft legally sound Right to Information (RTI) applications without needing prior legal or administrative knowledge.
ideas.problem_statement: Reimagine Government: Rethink how citizens interact with government websites and digital services.
ideas.title: RTI-Draft
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages interdisciplinary collaboration (combining law, public policy, and tech) which is explicitly encouraged by the organizers for non-CS participants.

ideas.pitch: An intuitive, conversational tax filing assistant designed for small business owners and commerce students to demystify GST filings and municipal tax payments.
ideas.problem_statement: Reimagine Government: Rethink how citizens interact with government websites and digital services.
ideas.title: TaxClear
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly empowers Commerce, BBA, and MBA participants by integrating business logic with a streamlined digital public service interface.
